text: {"score":4,"justification":"The summary is accurate and grounded. Numbers match the card: 8.2% vs 2.1% expected, score 9.26, z 0.65, 63% low complexity, 16 records, 0 of 12. The cited claims fit their sentences: Z09 and R21 claims are low-complexity 99215s, and C0014117 and C0014493 are high-complexity. The language is cautious (leaning inconclusive), and it flags the missing 99215 documentation. The first next step in the summary text, requesting charts for low-complexity 99215 claims, is concrete. The formal next_steps list is generic and omits that specific request. There are also some wording and consistency problems.","problems":["Formal next_steps are generic (larger sample of 99214 and 99215, re-screen) and do not include the specific request for low-complexity 99215 charts that the rationale recommends.","Claim that the 99215 share is above the all-provider rate in every complexity band is true per the card, but the plain z-score of 0.65 (not elevated vs peers) is not reconciled with 'well above' in the headline.","'0 of 12 notes claiming moderate-or-higher data reviewed had no lab' is awkwardly worded and confusing, and could be read as a negative finding.","Says 'The claims pattern points toward upcoding' while leaning is 'inconclusive', which is a slight tonal tension.","The M54.50 visits are named as starting points but are not among the cited examples. The cited examples list shows only two claims, one with 1 condition, so it is thin and does not highlight the strongest cases.","The 99213/99214 notes 'all supported the billed level' rests on only 16 records, and the card lists no examples, so the claim is thinly supported."]}
